title: Payments to two different muxed IDs of one account in the same ledger
pattern: Two payments in one ledger reach M(bob, 100) and M(bob, 200): two muxed addresses, one base account. Readers keyed by base account must keep both IDs; readers keyed by M address must not create two accounts. wallet-backend#693 mishandled two muxed IDs of one account in one ledger.

hazards.placement: two PaymentOp.destination muxed IDs over one base account in one ledger

facts.says: This payment goes to bob muxed with ID 100.
The same ledger holds the payment to bob muxed with ID 200.
